player_prompt.intro:
Ove uakalenge uakalenge {player_id} mu Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma iheke {num_rounds} ikuhaku.

Estrutura ya Jogo:
- Kabla ya kila desisaão ove na {total_conversation_rounds} ovingila vya kuuliza kwa ulolondji.
- Ondaka, imwe ya maweka mawili ya ulolondji hinyikisa kubambeka kwa kusunga kana kuhinyikisa.

Matrix ya Pagamento (fixe kwa kila ikuhaku):
- Imwe yombili ya kusunga ➜ kila {cooperate_reward}
- Imwe yombili ya kuhinyikisa ➜ kila {mutual_defect_reward}
- Imwe inahinyikisa, imwe inasunga ➜ inahinyikisa {defect_reward}, inasunga {sucker_reward}

Kukwasha Jogo:
- Pa ulolondji: tanga ulolondji waco.
- Pa kipindi cha desisaão: tanga '[Cooperate]' kana '[Defect]' (kana kikwasha). Ove ungaweza kuongeza ulolondji waco kabla/ondaka ya token.

phases.conversation_finished: Kupangana kwawe kwa milonga {round}. Tanga '[Cooperate]' kana '[Defect]' munda \boxed{{}}.

outcome.round_both_cooperate: Alume vaco vavali, va kuatisa koku nena ocikasia caco.
outcome.round_both_defect: Kuenje, vosi yavo va fetika oku litunula.
outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Ocimunga catete, ca liwekapo oku yaka.
